resources.string: Each row has its own amount. Only the rows on screen have views; scrolling rebinds them, and each rebound row configures its one promo button again. A render still in flight for the old row is superseded, and its late reply is ignored.

The native API shows HTML only when Affirm turns on android_sdk_migrate_native_to_html_render for the merchant. Until then it shows native text. The chosen renderer and why the HTML failed are logged under the Affirm logcat tag.
Only the default, sans-serif, serif and monospace typefaces (regular, bold, italic, bold italic) map to HTML. Other fonts, such as one from res/font, stay native.
Native API. Shown as HTML when the flag is on, with this font, size and color. Falls back to native text if the HTML fails.
Explicit HTML. Always HTML, with browser default text and margins. Hidden, not replaced, if the HTML fails.
